limitations: Defaults are not represented in declaration types and are not extracted (K1b-Q5 profile).

cursor.description: Present iff the actor has published a caret (§5.6). Anchors, never offsets.

actors.description: Co-viewers; current actor excluded by the host (B2 §5.1).

total.description: Count including the current actor (B2 §5.1; restored in r2).

hrMetadata.description:
Full wrapper metadata of a horizontal-rule atom (spec R-FULL-HR-1).
Wrapper/grouping keys only; never `blockKind`, `headingLevel` or
`codeLanguage`. Absent materializes the canonical defaults.

metadata.description:
Full text-block metadata (spec R-FULL-META-1). Present iff this block
belongs to a `ds.markdown.full@1` document and kind is "paragraph".
Absent materializes the canonical plain defaults on capture.

paragraphId.description: Opaque per-block identity, host-supplied. See spec §5.2.

preservedKind.description:
Preserved block kind as segmented host-side (e.g. "heading",
"list", "table", "codeBlock", "diagram"). Display only.

raw.description:
Verbatim source slice of a preserved block. Present iff
kind === "preserved". Never edited, never reserialised.

segments.description:
Ordered inline runs of a full text block (spec §4.3.2). Present iff
this block belongs to a `ds.markdown.full@1` document and kind is
"paragraph". Code lines are `hardBreak` segments per R-FULL-CODE-1.

text.description:
Editable paragraph text (Markdown inline source for
`focus.markdown.p0@1`, literal text for `text/plain`).
Present iff kind === "paragraph" on a P0 document. Full text blocks
carry `segments`/`metadata` instead and never use this field.

document.description: The complete new controlled value. The only content the component emits.

gesture.description: Provenance of the single completed gesture that produced `document`.

representability.description: Paragraphs of `document` whose wire is non-representable (§6.6).

retainedRunMetadata.description:
Full-profile only (`ds.markdown.full@1`): the §4.3.2 run-source
retention map. Absent (or empty) when every referenced run source is
live on its own block; present entries survive capture, copy and
remount so promotion never transfers run ownership.

affectedParagraphIds.description:
Ordered `paragraphId` values of the blocks the gesture touched,
in resulting document order.

gestureId.description: Opaque identifier of this completed gesture, allocated by the component.

merge.description:
Present iff kind === "merge": the surviving identity and the identities
consumed by the merge, which the component never reallocates.

paste.description:
Present iff kind === "paste": the freshly allocated identities of the
inserted blocks and whether the paste entered from inside this editor
session or from outside it.

split.description:
Present iff kind === "split": the block that was split and the fresh
identities allocated for the tail blocks, in document order.

lockLabel.description:
CL-2 live composition seam (§6.4): lock summary template, "{holder}"
interpolated with the holder display label.

noLockLabel.description: CL-2 live composition seam (§6.4): no-lock summary text.

presenceLabel.description:
CL-2 live composition seam (§6.4): presence summary template,
"{count}" interpolated with the co-viewer total. Optional: a missing
key renders the `⟦untranslated:collab.presenceLabel⟧` marker.

requesterKeyLabel.description:
CL-1B badge (§6.4): accessible label of the requester key overlay,
"{label}" interpolated with the requester display label.

rosterLabel.description: CL-1B badge (§6.4): accessible label of the avatar roster.

tooltipLockedLabel.description:
CL-1B badge (§6.4): tooltip template when locked, "{holder}"
interpolated with the holder display label. Carries the request
wording; the read-only variant omits it.

tooltipLockedReadOnlyLabel.description:
CL-1B badge (§6.4): tooltip template when locked in read-only mode,
"{holder}" interpolated. Omits the request wording.

tooltipUnlockedLabel.description: CL-1B badge (§6.4): tooltip text when no lock is active.

unlockRequestLabel.description: CL-2 live composition seam (§6.4): request-unlock action text.

composing.description: True while an IME composition is in progress in the editor.

ready.description:
True iff no composition is in progress and the last emitted document
is the displayed revision. The host captures only when ready.

rejectedKinds.description:
Non-paragraph block kinds the paste would have created, in clipboard
order, deduplicated (e.g. "table", "codeBlock", "heading", "list",
"blockquote", "image", "horizontalRule", "rawHtml").

actor.description: The local actor for this binding.

binding.description:
Full binding identity of the live field, if any. Present ⇒ live
(L2) surface: admission decides, the L0 lock snapshot below stays
information only and never drives `editable` (R-API-2).

lock.description:
L0 lock snapshot. Drives inertness only on controlled surfaces
(holder held by another actor ⇒ read-only); information only when
`binding` is present. An expired lock is passed as `null`.

profile.description:
Content profile (R-FULL-PROFILE-1): `p0` (default) or the CL-2F
`full` profile. `full` requires `value.format` to be
`ds.markdown.full@1`; a mismatch refuses the mount.

provider.description:
Injected collaboration provider. Accepted beside the editor; no
provider call happens in CL-2. Absent ⇒ controlled mode.
